result:
All checks pass: typecheck, lint, the targeted pulls test, and i18n consistency. As instructed, I haven't pushed anything.

Summary of changes:
- `desktop/src/renderer/lib/pulls.ts`: added pure helper `labelToggle(id, number, label, on)` returning a `LabelEdit`.
- `desktop/src/renderer/components/PullRequestsPanel.tsx`: `toggleLabel` now takes a PR number and uses `labelToggle`; the labels mutation's `onSuccess` also updates the cached `['pull', project, number]` detail so the modal stays in sync; `LabelPill` gained a hover/focus-visible X button (`aria-label` from the new i18n key, `stopPropagation` so it doesn't open the modal); `PullRequestModal` now receives `labelEdits` and `onToggleLabel`.
- `desktop/src/renderer/components/PullRequestModal.tsx`: labels shown in the header now go through `withEdits` (so pending edits/removals apply there too) and `LabelChip` got the same X button pattern, wired to the new props.
- Added `memory.pulls.labels.remove` to both `en-US.ts` and `pt-BR.ts`.
- Added a `pulls.test.ts` case for `labelToggle`.

One thing worth a quick look when you get a chance to actually run the app: I didn't launch the desktop app to visually confirm the hover/focus X buttons and the modal's label removal — only typecheck/lint/unit tests were run, per the task's check list.
